events.note: 404: the occupation ends with the close of the war. Slaves escaped to Decelea 'from 413 until the close of the Peloponnesian War in 404 BC'; Athens surrendered on 25 April 404 (delian-league ledger/26). Replaces the dossiers' skipped event.

correction.text: Jiang County and Quwo County, the area around Jiang and Quwo left to the dukes

keyframe_overrides.why: The keyframe started in 404 and stripped Jin of about 730 cells a year before the partition, leaving them ownerless for 404. The page dates the division to the next year: 'So, in 403 BCE, they divided the state's lands among themselves'; Jin keeps Jiang and Quwo afterwards. The shape and the end year are unchanged; only the start moves from 404 to 403.
